preconditions.description: The number of rows R must be between 1 and 20.
The number of columns C must be between 1 and 20.

postconditions.description: The length of the output sequence of instructions must not exceed 10,000 characters.

postconditions.expression: all(c in 'LRUD' for c in stdout)
postconditions.description: The output must only contain the characters 'L', 'R', 'U', and 'D'.

postconditions.expression: any((x, y) for x in range(1, R+1) for y in range(1, C+1) if (x, y) != (0, 0))
postconditions.description: The sequence must be such that the final position of the robot uniquely determines the position of the obstacle.
